items.title: Yan drifts from -183 to -149; Dvalishvili in to +127
items.summary: Consensus moved about 4.8% toward Dvalishvili across 23 books. DraftKings Yan is -135 (opened -185), FanDuel -144.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: DK -135 is the best Yan price but sits right at the market's ~57%, so there's no gap to bet.

items.title: Main event settles at pick'em
items.summary: Early lines had Evloev -185 / Volkanovski +160, then it flipped to roughly even. Now it's -108/-108 consensus; DK -110/-110, FD -108/-108.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: no stat edge on a coin flip.

items.title: Pico steamed from -103 to -148; Keita flips to +126
items.summary: Biggest move on the card (10.5% implied): Keita opened a -121 favorite and is now a +126 underdog.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: we'd be chasing a move that's already done.

items.title: Undercard moves: Vagaev, Oki/Santos, Chopurov, Lucindo
items.summary: Vagaev shortened from -194 to -151 (money toward Malkoun), Santos/Oki went from -144/+116 to -115/-104, Chopurov -514 to -600, and Lucindo -361 to -405 after Caliari's miss.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: no news explains these beyond the Caliari miss.

items.title: Christian Kirk expected back; Jordan Watkins leads thin SF WR room
items.summary: Kirk (calf) is listed questionable but Shanahan plans to activate him. SF's top four Week 1 receivers are all unavailable.

items.title: 49ers rule out Mike Evans, Nick Bosa, Deebo Samuel at ATL
items.summary: Shanahan ruled out WR Mike Evans (Achilles), DE Nick Bosa (calf), WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring), LBs Wallow and Gifford, and S Sigle. Evans and Bosa won't travel to Atlanta.

items.title: Chiefs without both starting tackles at SEA
items.summary: RT Jaylon Moore is out (concussion) and LT Josh Simmons went on IR this week. WR Rashee Rice and RB Brashard Smith are out; CB L'Jarius Sneed is questionable, and Kelce (ankle) has no game status.

items.title: Seahawks: Charbonnet, Thomas, Surratt out; Emmanwori questionable
items.summary: RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) stays out and LBs Drake Thomas and Chazz Surratt are out. S Nick Emmanwori (hip, new Friday) plus Lawrence, Nwosu and O'Toole are questionable, and RG Anthony Bradford returns from IR.

items.title: Caliari misses weight by 4.5 lbs
items.summary: Nicolle Caliari weighed 120.5 lbs, 4.5 over the 116-lb non-title strawweight limit; Iasmin Lucindo made 115. The bout goes on at catchweight and Caliari forfeits 30% of her purse to Lucindo.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: Lucindo is already about -405 and a 4.5-lb miss could mean a bad cut or a size edge, so no clear angle.

items.title: Volkanovski 144.5, Evloev 145: main event official
items.summary: Both featherweight title fighters made weight: Alexander Volkanovski 144.5 and Movsar Evloev 145.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: clean weigh-in, true pick'em near -108 each.

items.title: Yan and Dvalishvili both 135: co-main official
items.summary: Petr Yan and Merab Dvalishvili each weighed 135 lbs for their bantamweight title trilogy.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: no weigh-in red flags for either man.

items.title: Rest of main card makes weight
items.summary: Kavanagh 125.5 vs Temirov 126, Volkov 256 vs Kuniev 265, Pico 145.5 vs Keita 146. All on weight.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: no weigh-in news here.

items.title: All other prelim fighters make weight
items.summary: Murzakanov 206/Reyes 205, Krylov 206/Yakhyaev 206, Magomedov 185.5/Rowston 185, Dawson 156/Aliev 155, Thicknesse 135.5/Chopurov 136, Vagaev 185.5/Malkoun 186, Oki 146/Santos 146, Steele 156/Gugnon 156. Caliari was the only miss on the 28-fighter card.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: nothing at the scale moves these.

items.title: Yan's first fight back after January back surgery
items.summary: Petr Yan had nine-hour lumbar surgery in January and fights about nine months later. Sean O'Malley said that could be too soon, but no new injury has been reported and Yan made weight.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: this is the likely reason Yan drifted, and we can't price the risk better than the market.

items.title: Arnold Allen out; Losene Keita faces Aaron Pico
items.summary: Allen withdrew in mid-September, still rehabbing from past treatments, and Keita (off a Sept. 5 first-round KO) replaced him against Pico. The fight is on and both made weight.
items.edge_take: Still a pass: the market already priced it (see Pico line move).
